title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2
japaneseTitle: トニー・ホーク プロスケーター 2
composer: Various Artists (Bad Religion, Rage Against the Machine, Papa Roach)
shortDescription: Neversoft's perfection of the arcade extreme sports formula that introduced the manual and one of gaming's greatest punk-rock soundtracks.
historicalSignificance: Introduced the 'manual' trick mechanic which allowed players to string street tricks and halfpipe airs into endless unbroken multi-million-point combos, achieving a near-unanimous 98 Metacritic rating and cementing extreme sports in popular culture.

editorialContent.overview: Developed by Neversoft under Joel Jewett and published by Activision under their Activision O2 extreme sports brand in September 2000, Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 2 stands as one of the highest critically rated video games of all time. Building on the runaway success of the 1999 original, THPS2 captured the turn-of-the-millennium cultural explosion of the X Games, pop-punk, and alternative skateboarding lifestyle.
editorialContent.gameplay: Each park presents a tight 2-minute timer to accomplish high scores, find the hidden VHS tape, collect the letters S-K-A-T-E, and complete environmental goals. The revolutionary inclusion of the manual (tapping up-down upon landing) let skilled players link vert ramps, grinds, and flatland flip tricks into dizzying score multipliers.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Neversoft refined the Havok-inspired arcade skating physics to silky precision, added an intuitive 3D Skate Park Editor, and engineered real-time audio playback that integrated iconic licensed tracks from Rage Against the Machine, Bad Religion, and Anthrax.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: THPS2 transformed skateboarding into a mainstream global youth obsession. Generations of players discovered alternative rock, hip-hop, and urban skate apparel through the game, elevating Tony Hawk and pro street skaters to worldwide celebrity.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved across original PS1, Dreamcast, and PC CD-ROMs, and faithfully remade in 2020 by Vicarious Visions as Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 1 + 2.

awards: Metacritic score of 98 (second-highest of all time)

technicalSpecs.engine: Neversoft proprietary 3D engine with dynamic trick chain physics
technicalSpecs.soundChip: PlayStation SPU streaming compressed licensed audio tracks
